title: Step 1b - Preparing Datasets for Multiple Linear Regression in R

cues.en: Tutor: So I'm gonna jump back to my folder, part one: data precessing, which is here, and here we go.
cues.zh: 回到 Part 1 Data Preprocessing 資料夾，就在這裡。

cues.en: So the category called data, our file is here, so let's open it.
cues.zh: 類別資料編碼的 R 檔在這裡，打開。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And right now what I'm gonna do is I'm going to take this, copy.
cues.zh: 現在取這段，複製。

cues.en: So you have the same file, so you can also take it from your folder or take it from the course.
cues.zh: 你的資料夾也有相同檔案，也可以從課程取得。

cues.en: And let's go back to our multiple linear regression file and paste that here.
cues.zh: 回到多元線性迴歸檔案，貼在這裡。

cues.en: Then of course we need to change a few things here, so we need to change the name of our category called variable.
cues.zh: 當然要改幾個地方，先改類別變數名稱。

cues.en: So in part one it was country, and here it is state.
cues.zh: 第一部分是 Country，這裡則是 State。

cues.en: Same here, we need to change country by state.
cues.zh: 這裡也把 Country 換成 State。

cues.en: Let's not forget to align this, this is very important in R and in any programmation language.
cues.zh: 別忘了調整排版，對 R 及任何程式語言，整齊都很重要。

cues.en: Here we go, there.
cues.zh: 這樣。

cues.en: And now we need to change the levels.
cues.zh: 接著更改 levels。

cues.en: So before, you know the categorical variable was the countries, and the three categories were France, Spain, and Germany, and here our three categories are New York, California and Florida.
cues.zh: 先前是國家，France、Spain、Germany；現在三個類別是 New York、California、Florida。

cues.en: So let's do it on our dataset.
cues.zh: 來套用到資料集。

cues.en: Actually, I will close that because we no longer need it.
cues.zh: 這個檔案不需要了，先關閉。

cues.en: So here our levels are, we said New York, California, and Florida, okay.
cues.zh: levels 設成 New York、California、Florida。

cues.en: And then the labels, that is the numeric numbers, which are actually factors, the numeric factors that are going to replace these three texts here, New York, California and Florida
cues.zh: labels 則是要替代這些文字的數值標籤，不過它們實際上仍是因子，

cues.en: are these numbers you choose here for labels.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡選擇的數字。

cues.en: So here we have one, two, three, that means that New York is gonna be one, California is gonna be two, and Florida is gonna be three.
cues.zh: 使用 1、2、3，代表 New York 是 1、California 是 2、Florida 是 3。

cues.en: You're gonna see, I'm going to select this and execute.
cues.zh: 選取並執行。

cues.en: All right, and now let's look at our data set.
cues.zh: 現在看資料集。

cues.en: As you can see the state is now encoded with the 1, 2, 3 values.
cues.zh: 可以看到，State 已編成 1、2、3。

cues.en: So one for New York, two for California and three for Florida.
cues.zh: 1 是 New York，2 是 California，3 是 Florida。

cues.en: Let's go back.
cues.zh: 回到程式。

cues.en: Okay, so the encoding is done and that's a much better thing for our model.
cues.zh: 編碼完成，這對模型比較合適。

cues.en: Now our model has a greater chance to work.
cues.zh: 模型現在更有機會正常運作。

cues.en: And now the last thing we need to do is to split the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 最後，要切分訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So here let's not forget to change the name of the dependent variable here, which is not purchased but profit.
cues.zh: 別忘了改依變數名稱，這裡不是 Purchased，而是 Profit。

cues.en: And then we need to change a split ratio if necessary.
cues.zh: 如果需要，也修改切分比例。

cues.en: Let's see, we have 50 observations, so a good split could be to have 40 observations in a training set and 10 observations in a test set.
cues.zh: 共有 50 筆，可以用 40 筆訓練、10 筆測試。

cues.en: So that makes actually a 80% split ratio, 80% going to the training set.
cues.zh: 因此切分比例是 80%，也就是 80% 進入訓練集。

cues.en: And this is already what we have.
cues.zh: 這裡原本就這樣。

cues.en: Perfect, so we don't have to do anything here for the split ratio.
cues.zh: 很好，SplitRatio 不用改。

cues.en: And we are ready to take all of these and execute, and here we go.
cues.zh: 現在選取整段並執行。好了。

cues.en: Let's have a look at our training set and our test set.
cues.zh: 查看訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Here it is, that's the training set.
cues.zh: 這是訓練集。

cues.en: Okay, so it contains 40 entries for the observations, great.
cues.zh: 共有 40 筆觀測值，很好。

cues.en: We have our encoded variable for state, that's perfect.
cues.zh: State 也已正確編碼。

cues.en: And then the test set, that contains 10 observations and everything looks fine.
cues.zh: 測試集有十筆，一切看起來正常。

cues.en: All right, so let's go back to multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 回到多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: And the last step is feature scaling.
cues.zh: 最後一步是特徵縮放。

cues.en: But as for a simple linear regression we won't need to apply feature scaling manually, this will be taken care of with the function that we're gonna use to fit multiple linear regression
cues.zh: 但和簡單線性迴歸一樣，這裡不需要手動縮放，接下來用來擬合多元線性迴歸的函式，

cues.en: to our training set.
cues.zh: 可以直接處理這份訓練資料。

cues.en: So we're all fine, we're all good here, we are ready to move on to the next step, and that's what we are gonna do in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 所以一切準備好，下一堂就進下一步。

cues.en: Thank you for watching this one and I look forward to seeing you in the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝觀看，期待下一堂課見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
